phase3_findings.description: Diff-added prose asserting 'injection behaves exactly as before' (config.py field description) / 'injection is unchanged' (enhancer __init__ docstring) is an overstated absolute: pre-change the enhancer's text-injection floor was a fixed 0.7 and was not wired from config, whereas post-change it tracks similarity_threshold, so with a non-default similarity_threshold (band still disabled) injection differs from before. Filed by the agent as Important documented_falsehood. Adjudication: the flagged prose is behavior-inert (Phase 4.1.5 cap) — limb one holds (no tool parses a pydantic Field description or a Python docstring to decide behavior), limb two holds (the description is NOT surfaced to any consumer: `sqllens init` writes a static _SAMPLE_CONFIG at cli.py:610, config_admin.html uses its own hardcoded help text, and docs/external/configuration.md is hand-authored), first conjunct holds (subject is the sentence, not a coverage gap; the band mechanism is correct). AC3 itself DEFINES 'behave exactly as before' as 'the band is empty and no memory is injected on account of it', which the code satisfies universally. Capped to Suggestion; does NOT invoke the self-contradicting-diff carve-out and does not drive REJECT at the default critical threshold.
phase3_findings.inertness_annotation: [inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: pydantic Field.description and a Python docstring are not tool-read for behavior; sqllens init emits static _SAMPLE_CONFIG (cli.py:610) not field descriptions, config_admin.html has its own hardcoded help, docs/external/configuration.md is hand-authored — so no external consumer reads this description]

phase3_findings.description: Partial-degrade: search_text_memories runs first and may succeed, then search_similar_usage runs inside the same broad try; if only the band search raises, the single except discards the already-fetched valid text memories and returns the bare prompt (narrower than the prior text-only success path). Benign, logged, safely degrading. Suggest wrapping only the new band search in its own try -> band_pairs=[] fallback.

Pre-existing broad `except Exception` -> logger.warning without exc_info or the in-scope request_id masks programming errors as routine memory unavailability. Advisory (pre-existing + vendored agent/ tree); the PR relies on this handler for its new degrade path.

test_band_injects_both_memory_kinds_as_prose asserts only that the question and SQL substrings appear; the AC5 'render as prose, not a tool-call shape' contract (the failure mode AC5 warns against) is not machine-checked — a regression rendering the pair as a tool-call/JSON shape would still contain both substrings and stay green. Recommend asserting the distinctive prose framing literal ('Related prior question' / 'was answered with this SQL:'). Below the default critical verdict threshold; does not gate the verdict but is the strongest quality note.

The band's `< strict` upper bound is not pinned at the boundary: test_band_excludes_strict_tier_pairs uses score 0.9 vs strict 0.7, so it does not distinguish `<` from `<=`. A flip to `<= strict` would leak an exactly-at-strict pair into injection uncaught. Recommend a pair at score == strict asserted absent.

No coverage at the inclusive band floor (score == context_similarity_threshold). The floor filter lives in the memory layer (faithfully mirrored by the stub), so lower value, but one boundary case would pin inclusive-lower-bound end to end.

Degrade-path test only exercises the text search raising; since text search runs first in the shared try, search_similar_usage raising is never independently exercised. Thematically related to the silent-failure-hunter partial-degrade note.
The strictly-greater band-disabled case (context 0.9, strict 0.7) is untested; the equal-threshold no-op reasonably covers the >= boundary, so minor.

DefaultLlmContextEnhancer re-exposes the two thresholds as unvalidated public mutable floats and trusts its caller for the range/ordering invariant that MemoryConfig enforces (the direct constructor accepts e.g. similarity_threshold=5.0). Consider a small frozen ContextBand(floor, strict) value object consolidating the ordering/range invariant instead of re-deriving it at each min()/< site. Low severity; production path is validated via the factory.

Positive note (no action): _StubAgentMemory is a high-fidelity test double implementing all 9 AgentMemory abstract methods with matching kw-only signatures and mirroring the real ChromaAgentMemory `>= similarity_threshold` gate (agent_memory.py:251,423), so the band tests are meaningful. SPDX header present.

Both memory searches use limit=5, soft-capping band size; AC4 phrases injection as 'every memory in [floor,strict)' but the shipped field description does not overclaim ('are injected as related context', no 'every'), and limit=5 matches the pre-change text-injection behavior — not a documented falsehood, flagged only so the soft cap is a conscious choice. No change required. Final-pass overall assessment: merge-ready, all 6 non-deferred ACs satisfied, band boundaries correct with no off-by-one or double injection, factory wiring reaches the enhancer with both thresholds over a shared memory instance.
